scope: Data-only fixture obligations, not a second roadmap; live task status remains tasks/backlog.md. No consumer implementation is modified.
evidence_level: Verified source behavior and signatures; no v5 behavioral acceptance executed. Source hashes bind evidence to actual content; repository commit identifies checked-out revision.

boundaries.rho: values, preservation, graph components, storage, native exact access, certified cuts and complete changes
boundaries.sigma: adapter, IR, relational and temporal execution, inference, solver and computation progress
boundaries.ai_soc: source semantics, materialization and product parity

obligations.ownership: sigma-tkgd adapter; rho public storage/access contract
obligations.required_adaptation: Replace (0,0)=Eternal and to=0=infinite sentinels with explicit scope forms; zero is an ordinary coordinate.
required_tests: Point(0), finite bound 0, Unplaced, All, and infinite right remain distinct through row and column adapters.

obligations.ownership: ai-assisted-soc-v2 adapter; rho public storage/access contract
obligations.required_adaptation: Replace deliberate epsilon-widened degenerate observations with explicit points and adapt paired window compensation. Never reinterpret genuine one-tick spans solely by width.
required_tests: Exact quiet-gap floor and adjacent points match kernel answers after paired adaptation.
Genuine one-tick span remains a span; degenerate source observation remains a point.

obligations.ownership: ai-assisted-soc-v2 adapter; rho public storage/access contract
obligations.required_adaptation: Declare units and rounding when mapping source seconds into the default millisecond axis; retain original source times as provenance when available.
required_tests: Submillisecond differences survive an explicitly selected exact profile or produce declared conversion evidence; no inferred higher precision.

obligations.ownership: ai-assisted-soc-v2 adapter; rho public storage/access contract
obligations.required_adaptation: Move latest supporting signal ingestion time from AddWithTx database backfill into explicit source ingestion provenance. Database revisions commit at certified new cuts.
required_tests: Late old-source assertion preserves source time but cannot enter an earlier certified database cut.

obligations.ownership: sigma-tkgd adapter; rho public storage/access contract
obligations.required_adaptation: Translate TxPin/TxAt to explicit snapshot and validity selections; never inherit TxAt implicit valid-now filtering.
required_tests: Past-valid facts remain visible at a pure database cut.
Bitemporal point/range selection uses explicit validity and historical labels/properties.

obligations.ownership: sigma-tkgd adapter; rho public storage/access contract
obligations.required_adaptation: Adapt scalar snapshot TxPin and CommittedTx to certified cut handles and retention leases without treating a maximum timestamp as a certificate.
required_tests: Eager/lazy snapshots and all scan/adjacency doors agree at a cut after later mutation/deletion.
Expired or unresolved cuts are distinguishable from exact-empty.

obligations.ownership: sigma-tkgd adapter; rho public storage/access contract
obligations.required_adaptation: Adapt GraphTx wrapper to v5 isolation, private writes, atomic visibility and durable receipts; CommittedLSN uint64 is not a distributed cut certificate.
required_tests: Concurrent reader sees none or all of a committed multi-component transaction.
Rollback hides private writes; ambiguous/durable outcomes and errors.Is sentinels propagate.

obligations.ownership: sigma-tkgd adapter; rho public storage/access contract
obligations.required_adaptation: Keep opaque 64-bit IDs and explicit ascending-ID enumeration where required; remove placement assumptions and separate enumeration from temporal order.
required_tests: Row/column fact sequences agree across sealing, rebalance and 1/2/4/8 partitions.
Duplicate coordinates preserve distinct IDs.

obligations.ownership: sigma-tkgd adapter; rho public storage/access contract
obligations.required_adaptation: Extend normalization explicitly for new exact values; do not turn unsupported rational/temporal/uncertainty kinds into nil or erase temporal kind through an ISO string conversion.
required_tests: 1/3, temporal kind, present-null and missing round-trip independently with row/column parity.
Unsupported profile is explicit decline/error.

obligations.ownership: rho stores complete exact inputs; sigma owns IR and evaluation
obligations.required_adaptation: Keep complete snapshots, endpoint and annotation pieces before sigma operator evaluation. Preserve projection-before-box and empty-window semantics in sigma tests.
required_tests: E09/E21 complete input preservation in rho; actual window/join/annotation evaluation and retractions in sigma.

obligations.ownership: ai-assisted-soc-v2 adapter; rho public storage/access contract
obligations.required_adaptation: Preserve explicit support/provenance references from kernel maps; do not assume HOP row properties contain support or duplicated t_lo/t_hi.
required_tests: Imported HOP resolves its exact supporting source identities without reconstructing them from latest state.

obligations.ownership: ai-assisted-soc-v2 adapter; rho public storage/access contract
obligations.required_adaptation: Adapt HOP declaration, memory budget and fresh temporary segment directory lifecycle to v5 storage contracts.
required_tests: Declared/undeclared and row/column answers agree across seals and reopen; directory ownership and cleanup remain explicit.

obligations.ownership: sigma-tkgd adapter; rho public storage/access contract
obligations.required_adaptation: Review NodeByIDAt actual adapter: it currently handles valid-time fields but falls back to current NodeByID for options carrying only tx pins. Map all supported v5 selector dimensions explicitly.
required_tests: Create X, mutate Y, then point lookup with historical cut returns X; generic lookup equals named/history/column doors.

obligations.ownership: sigma-tkgd adapter; rho public storage/access contract
obligations.required_adaptation: Select declared/effective relationship view explicitly rather than allowing the chosen scan/snapshot/adjacency door to determine endpoint-life masking.
required_tests: Close endpoint life, retain asserted edge evidence, reopen life; every selected view agrees across read doors.
